title: BUG: CCID wp11_ccid_close() releases interface 0 regardless of which was claimed
description: wp11_ccid_open() discovers the CCID interface number dynamically (stored in local variable iface_num). struct wp11_ccid_ctx has no field to store it. wp11_ccid_close() calls libusb_release_interface(ctx->usb_dev, 0) hardcoded to interface 0. For any device where the CCID interface is not at index 0, the wrong interface is released. Fix: add int claimed_iface to struct wp11_ccid_ctx, set it in open(), use it in close(). Add comment explaining why.
